title: Stochastic ensemble calibration and post-quantization bias correction for E4M3/E5M2 on Hopper
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Enable a robust FP8 activation selection pipeline for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) by combining multiple stochastic calibration seeds, an ensemble scoring layer, and a lightweight post-quantization bias-correction pass. This ticket addresses edge-case regressions observed in long-tail prompt families and conversational context drift when using single-seed calibration. The aim is to reduce worst-case accuracy drops while keeping latency impact within SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Golden suite passthrough: no more than 0.5% degradation in macro-F1 on the golden eval set compared to FP32 for top-100 prompts after correction
Canary rollout gate: 99th percentile token-latency increase <= 12ms on canary cluster under production traffic profile
Stability: no more than 0.2% of requests hit automated rollback triggers (semantic regression or perplexity spike) during 72-hour dark-launch runs
Automated regression alerts integrated into Console: dataset-level drift signal, per-model bias metric, and canary health channel set up
implementation_notes: Add stochastic calibration harness that runs N=5 calibration seeds per profile and computes per-layer variance maps
Implement lightweight ensemble scorer that weights seed outputs by layer-consistency and end-to-end likelihood on a held-out prefix set
Post-quant bias correction: estimate small additive correction vectors on activations using O(1k) labeled samples per profile; apply as kernel-level bias shim at runtime
Integrate the ensemble decision into the profile-activation flow: decision = (ensemble_score >= threshold) && per-layer-variance < cap
Preserve KV-cache semantics: calibration shims must be prefix-invariant; add unit tests for cache preservation across short/long context transitions
Optimize for latency: candidate selection executes asynchronously during warmstart; final bias-correction is a fused kernel to avoid extra memcpy
Expose tunables in Dedicated and Private: ensemble_count, ensemble_threshold, bias_correction_scale, and fallback_hysteresis
telemetry_checks: Per-profile accuracy delta (FP8 vs FP32) with 95% CI reported hourly
Per-layer variance heatmap emitted from calibration harness; alert if variance drift > 3x baseline
Canary traffic SLOs: p50/p95/p99 latency and token ASP (tokens/sec) compared to baseline (no-quant)
Semantic regression detector: BLEU/ROUGE/F1 on random prompt buckets; auto-create Jira incident when regression > 1% on production samples
Shadow-sample pool coverage: report percentage of requests that match any calibration bucket; goal >= 85%
rollback_plan: Automatic: if canary regression triggers (configurable thresholds) then revert profile activation to last-known-good profile via runtime feature flag
Manual: Ops runbook to disable ensemble decision and enable conservative INT8/FP16 fallback per model
Hotfix: ship emergency bias-correction toggle to disable post-quant shim if it causes stability regressions
Postmortem: capture failing sample set and annotate with seed-level calibration diagnostics for offline analysis
